scope: code quality and functional regressions against HEAD b05f3e2cdbccdc6a04e8b800c00e26bf80f16110
fresh Play, retained A-to-B switching, parent/child projection, temporary Gateway unavailability and recovery
non_goals: new abstractions unrelated to an observed regression

findings.finding: A normal fresh stream had no retained-transport record, so verified process/window evidence could not reach READY and automatic reveal could remain closed.
findings.correction: READY accepts verified correlated provider evidence before a stream becomes retained, while a matching reconnect-required transport remains excluded.

findings.finding: Verified idle game evidence on a healthy HOME_LIVE/PARKED_LIVE transport could age into RECOVERY_REQUIRED and block the next retained Play.
findings.correction: The game axis resolves to IDLE while the independently known-live neutral transport remains ACTIVE and reusable.

findings.finding: A rejected delayed observation could still expose raw game state and trigger current-transition stop/focus/capture effects.
findings.correction: Rejected observations no longer populate the facade snapshot, and transition side effects require an accepted gateway observation.

findings.finding: ConsoleActivity could bypass the canonical bounded UNAVAILABLE projection when the first observation attempt failed and no retained transport existed.
findings.correction: After the first observation attempt, Activity consumes the projection owner even before an observation is accepted.

findings.finding: The first stale-revision fixture was internally inconsistent and exercised parser rejection instead of the accept-false path.
findings.correction: The fixture now returns a valid verified running observation with an older revision and a different game identity; the focused class passes through the intended branch.

review_recheck: PASS for the three production corrections; they are minimal and no new UX/stability regression was found in the reviewed scope.
validation: Focused three-class regression run: 86 tests, initial 4 expected failures before fixes, then PASS after corrections.
Full Android NonRoot unit gate: 115 suites, 1126 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped.
NonRoot Debug and Release assembly: 99 tasks, PASS.
